subject.title: fix(ci): include runtime resources in build artifact

question: Should OpenClaw accept replacing the `dist-runtime-build` artifact producer with this repository-owned pack-and-smoke script once exact-head artifact-producing CI is green?
rationale: The code review found no concrete patch defect, but the diff changes a CI artifact producer that downstream proof workflows depend on, so accepting that operational risk is a maintainer merge choice.

options.title: Land with artifact proof
options.body: Merge once the current head or merge queue keeps the artifact-producing `build-artifacts` job green with pack, verify, ACP import, and Gateway `/readyz` proof.

options.title: Require proof refresh after changes
options.body: If the artifact script or workflow step changes again before merge, wait for a fresh artifact-producing CI run before accepting the risk.

recommendation.title: Land with artifact proof
recommendation.body: Merge once the current head or merge queue keeps the artifact-producing `build-artifacts` job green with pack, verify, ACP import, and Gateway `/readyz` proof.
